name: Doctor Kirvowski’s Fables and Legends
body:
Author Milos Kirvowski, human, CG; Language Common.
Alphabet common; DC 18; Pages 370 Price 7,610 gp; Weight 4.2 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Written when he was only twenty-four years old, Doctor Kirvowski’s collection of folklore still spellbinds its readers. Currently sixty-three years old, Doctor Kirvowski rarely discusses the work that showered him with accolades as well as misfortune. Hailed by his university as the foremost study of the undead, the unsuspecting author became the unlikely target of several kidnapping and murder plots concocted by covetous necromancers and evil clerics. Frightened by the unwelcome attention, the young doctor fled the university, disappearing from public view for more than thirty years. He recently emerged from hiding, but remains unwilling to discuss his research about the living dead. To the best of anyone’s knowledge, approximately twenty copies of the paper paged, leather-bound manual exist, although rumors claim that Doctor Kirvowski himself owns at least a dozen of them.

The character receives a +1 insight bonus on AC and attack rolls against the undead. The manual also provides a +2 insight bonus to all Knowledge (religion) checks pertaining to the undead.

MISINTERPRETATION

Misinterpretation The reader receives a -1 insight penalty on AC and attack rolls against the undead, and a -1 insight penalty to all Knowledge (religion) checks pertaining to the undead.

Gross Misinterpretation The reader receives a -1 insight penalty on AC, and attack rolls against the undead, and a -2 insight penalty to all Knowledge (religion) checks pertaining to the undead.
